answer.reason: The verses tell what Zebul did: he warned Abimelech against Gaal and later drove Gaal out of Shechem.

clauses.english: sent word secretly to Abimelech of Gaal's revolt and advised an attack on the city
clauses.quote: he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily

clauses.english: thrust Gaal and his brethren out of Shechem
clauses.quote: Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.
